definitions.adverse_weather: at least one of rain/snow/drizzle/thunderstorm/squall/fog/mist; overlapping categories collapsed with OR
definitions.after_gap: [first observed timestamp after a gap >1h, +24h); only hours remaining in complete-history validation cohort
definitions.holiday: CSV-derived daily is_holiday; no external calendar

limits: Descriptive slicing after model selection; no causal claim
C30 history excludes many hours after gaps
Weather slices do not isolate weather effects from time or traffic level
